method: Freshly read the private Git view and diff, stable descriptor read contract, fixed Git environment and read_index callers, new real-Git regression, author natural-timing probes and exact-source before/after evidence. Cross-checked hashes and case outcomes; did not rerun the same Linux tests.
assessment: Index stat and bytes come from the same already-validated no-follow descriptor; concurrent size/mtime/ctime changes continue to fail closed.

Only newly-created private index/sharedindex copies receive the original atime/mtime; original repository bytes and timestamps are not written. Fixed config excludes repository hooks, fsmonitor, external diff and filters.

The byte-returning read_index wrapper preserves existing worktree callers. The new regression makes a real stat-cache collision without timing sleeps and requires native Git agreement plus unchanged original index.
The fixture SHA1 checksum belongs to the explicit Git SHA1 index format, not password hashing or a new production cryptographic mechanism.

validation.platform: 120 isolated Linux UID65534; author evidence independently inspected

limits: Focused independent repair review; whole-source review and full CI remain separately required.
No online deployment or paid inference.
